Trigger.Name: PRE-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('DLVY_ITEMS');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$LOV_BL_DLVRY_GLOBALS.DLVY_ITEMS_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$LOV_BL_DLVRY_GLOBALS.DLVY_ITEMS_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;
 def_where := CG$LOV_BL_DLVRY_GLOBALS.DLVY_ITEMS_WHERE;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('DLVY_ITEMS.ITEM_GDS_DESC');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(ITEM_GDS_DESC '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(ITEM_GDS_DESC '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(ITEM_GDS_DESC LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(ITEM_GDS_DESC ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 r_string := NAME_IN('DLVY_ITEMS.ITEM_MARK');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(ITEM_MARK '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(ITEM_MARK '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(ITEM_MARK LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(ITEM_MARK ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((MFST_PORT_CD, MFST_NBR, MFST_DT, ITEM_SEQ, BL_SEQ, MFST_TYPE) IN '||'(SELECT PORT_CD, MFST_NBR, MFST_DT, ITEM_SEQ, BL_SEQ, MFST_TYPE '||'FROM VSSL_BL_ITEMS WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 set_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE, def_where);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(33, 'Query criteria too complex - simplify and re-query'), 'E', 'OFG', 33);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJUST_WIDTH
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Adjust_Width IS
 Shift number;
 ret number;
 ENTER_POS number;
 EXECUTE_POS number;
 OK_POS number;
 CANCEL_POS number;

BEGIN
 if :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH < 4 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('عرض القائمة أقل من الحد المسموح به','INFORMATION');
 elsif :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH > 7.5 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('عرض القائمة أكبر من الحد المسموح به','INFORMATION');
 else
 Shift := 1.75 - ((:PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH - 4)/2);
 ENTER_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_ENTER', X_POS);
 EXECUTE_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_EXECUTE', X_POS);
 CANCEL_POS:= Get_Item_Property('PB_CANCEL', X_POS);
 OK_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_OK', X_POS);

 Set_Item_Property('PB_ENTER', X_POS, ENTER_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_EXECUTE', X_POS, EXECUTE_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_CANCEL', X_POS, CANCEL_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_OK', X_POS, OK_POS-Shift);

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', WIDTH, :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', WIDTH, :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH);
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJUST_HEIGHT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Adjust_Height IS
 V_HEIGHT number;
 SHIFT number;
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 IF :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT <= 12 THEN
 V_HEIGHT := Get_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT);
 SHIFT := (12 - :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT) * 0.25;
 V_HEIGHT := V_HEIGHT - SHIFT;

 :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS := :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS - SHIFT;

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT > 12 AND :PARAMETER.TARIFF_LOV = 0 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('لا يمكن عرض أكثر من 12 صف من البيانات','INFORMATION');
 ELSE
 V_HEIGHT := Get_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT);
 SHIFT := (:PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT - 12) * 0.25;
 V_HEIGHT := V_HEIGHT + SHIFT;

 :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS := :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS + SHIFT;

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);

 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGFK$QRY_DLVY_ITEMS_SDI_VBI_FK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGFK$QRY_DLVY_ITEMS_SDI_VBI_FK */
PROCEDURE CGFK$QRY_DLVY_ITEMS_SDI_VBI_FK(
 P_GDS_TYPE_CD IN OUT NUMBER /* Value in Item :DLVY_ITEMS.GDS_TYPE_CD. */
 ,P_CNTNR_SEQ IN OUT NUMBER /* Value in Item :DLVY_ITEMS.CNTNR_SEQ. */
 ,P_ITEM_MARK IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :DLVY_ITEMS.ITEM_MARK. */
 ,P_ITEM_GDS_DESC IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :DLVY_ITEMS.ITEM_GDS_DESC. */
 ,P_MFST_TYPE IN NUMBER /* Value in Item :DLVY_ITEMS.MFST_TYPE. */
 ,P_BL_SEQ IN NUMBER /* Value in Item :DLVY_ITEMS.BL_SEQ. */
 ,P_ITEM_SEQ IN NUMBER /* Value in Item :DLVY_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ. */
 ,P_MFST_DT IN DATE /* Value in Item :DLVY_ITEMS.MFST_DT. */
 ,P_MFST_NBR IN NUMBER /* Value in Item :DLVY_ITEMS.MFST_NBR. */
 ,P_MFST_PORT_CD IN NUMBER ) IS /* Value in Item :DLVY_ITEMS.MFST_PORT_CD. */
/* Query foreign key value/query lookup data. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT VBI.ITEM_GDS_DESC
 ,VBI.ITEM_MARK
 ,VBI.CNTNR_SEQ
 ,VBI.GDS_TYPE_CD
 FROM VSSL_BL_ITEMS VBI
 WHERE VBI.PORT_CD = P_MFST_PORT_CD
 AND VBI.MFST_NBR = P_MFST_NBR
 AND VBI.MFST_DT = P_MFST_DT
 AND VBI.ITEM_SEQ = P_ITEM_SEQ
 AND VBI.BL_SEQ = P_BL_SEQ
 AND VBI.MFST_TYPE = P_MFST_TYPE;
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO P_ITEM_GDS_DESC
 , P_ITEM_MARK
 , P_CNTNR_SEQ
 , P_GDS_TYPE_CD;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGFK$QRY_DLVY_ITEMS_SDI_SDO_FK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGFK$QRY_DLVY_ITEMS_SDI_SDO_FK */
PROCEDURE CGFK$QRY_DLVY_ITEMS_SDI_SDO_FK(
 P_L_SHAG_AGNT_ARBC_NAME IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :DLVY_ITEMS.L_SHAG_AGNT_ARBC_NAME. */
 ,P_L_IMP_ARBC_IMPR_NAME IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :DLVY_ITEMS.L_IMP_ARBC_IMPR_NAME. */
 ,P_L_SDO_IMPR_NBR IN OUT NUMBER /* Value in Item :DLVY_ITEMS.L_SDO_IMPR_NBR. */
 ,P_L_SDO_OWNER_NBR IN OUT NUMBER /* Value in Item :DLVY_ITEMS.L_SDO_OWNER_NBR. */
 ,P_L_SDO_MFST_DT IN OUT DATE /* Value in Item :DLVY_ITEMS.L_SDO_MFST_DT. */
 ,P_L_SDO_MFST_NBR IN OUT NUMBER /* Value in Item :DLVY_ITEMS.L_SDO_MFST_NBR. */
 ,P_L_SDO_MFST_TYPE IN OUT NUMBER /* Value in Item :DLVY_ITEMS.L_SDO_MFST_TYPE. */
 ,P_L_SDO_MFST_PORT_CD IN OUT NUMBER /* Value in Item :DLVY_ITEMS.L_SDO_MFST_PORT_CD. */
 ,P_DO_ISS_DT IN DATE /* Value in Item :DLVY_ITEMS.DO_ISS_DT. */
 ,P_DO_NBR IN NUMBER /* Value in Item :DLVY_ITEMS.DO_NBR. */
 ,P_PORT_CD IN NUMBER /* Value in Item :DLVY_ITEMS.PORT_CD. */
 ,P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR IN NUMBER ) IS /* Value in Item :DLVY_ITEMS.SHPG_AGNT_NBR. */
/* Query foreign key value/query lookup data. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT L_SDO.MFST_PORT_CD
 ,L_SDO.MFST_TYPE
 ,L_SDO.MFST_NBR
 ,L_SDO.MFST_DT
 ,L_SDO.OWNER_NBR
 ,L_SDO.IMPR_NBR
 ,L_IMP.ARBC_IMPR_NAME
 ,L_SHAG.AGNT_ARBC_NAME
 FROM SEA_DLVY_ORDERS L_SDO
 ,IMPORTERS L_IMP
 ,SHPG_AGNTS L_SHAG
 WHERE L_SDO.SHPG_AGNT_NBR = P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR
 AND L_SDO.PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND (L_SDO.DO_NBR = P_DO_NBR OR
 (L_SDO.DO_NBR IS NULL AND
 P_DO_NBR IS NULL ))
 AND (L_SDO.DO_ISS_DT = P_DO_ISS_DT OR
 (L_SDO.DO_ISS_DT IS NULL AND
 P_DO_ISS_DT IS NULL ))
 AND L_IMP.PORT_CD (+) = L_SDO.PORT_CD
 AND L_IMP.IMPR_NBR (+) = L_SDO.IMPR_NBR
 AND L_SHAG.SHPG_AGNT_NBR (+) = L_SDO.SHPG_AGNT_NBR;
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO P_L_SDO_MFST_PORT_CD
 , P_L_SDO_MFST_TYPE
 , P_L_SDO_MFST_NBR
 , P_L_SDO_MFST_DT
 , P_L_SDO_OWNER_NBR
 , P_L_SDO_IMPR_NBR
 , P_L_IMP_ARBC_IMPR_NAME
 , P_L_SHAG_AGNT_ARBC_NAME;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

PROCEDURE CALL_LOV IS
RET NUMBER;
 pl_id ParamList;

 BEGIN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('LOV_VSSL_BL_ITEMS');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('LOV_VSSL_BL_ITEMS');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list LOV_VSSL_BL_ITEMS ', 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE ', TEXT_PARAMETER,'قائمة أصناف البضاعــة');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH ', TEXT_PARAMETER, 6);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_X_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, 1.5);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_Y_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, .8);
IF (:SYSTEM.MODE <> 'ENTER_QUERY') THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(PL_ID,'STATUS',TEXT_PARAMETER,1);
END IF;



 CALL_FORM('LOV_VSSL_BL_ITEMS.fmx ',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);


 /* IF :GLOBAL.CTRY_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
 :MANIFESTS.LOAD_CTRY_CD :=:GLOBAL.CTRY_CD ;
 :MANIFESTS.COUNTRY_NAME :=:GLOBAL.CRTY_ARBC_NAME ;
 :GLOBAL.Exec_Query_Now := 1;*/


 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||'LOV_VSSL_BL_ITEMS'||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
 DECLARE
 errnum NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 errtxt VARCHAR2(80) := ERROR_TEXT;
 errtyp VARCHAR2(20) := ERROR_TYPE;
 alert_is alert;
 alert_button number;
 MsgTxt VARCHAR2(2000);

 BEGIN
 IF errnum = 41051 then
 null;
 else
 IF errtyp = 'FRM' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ش';
 ELSIF errtyp = 'ORA' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ق';
 END IF;

 IF DBMS_ERROR_CODE = ERR_DB.GET_DB_ERR_CD THEN
 MsgTxt := ERR_DB.GET_LAST_ERROR;
 ELSE
 MsgTxt := errtyp||'-'||TO_CHAR(errnum)||': '||errtxt;
 END IF;
 alert_is := find_alert('CFG_ERROR');

 if (not id_null(alert_is)) then
 set_alert_property(alert_is, ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT, MsgTxt );
 alert_button := show_alert(alert_is);
 else
 Message(MsgTxt);
 end if;

 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
end if;
 END;
